facts.fact: 接机重逢：六月南德州——推迟的午间航班无人接，深嗓问在等人吗 devil；行李箱一扔、跳进他怀里双腿环腰——他总是接得住她。
毕业捷报：三月完成实习、应导师之邀留任到毕业——十天前毕业礼，Brooks 与父母飞去观礼。
facts.anchor: my final kitchen internship is complete. I actually finished back in March, but I’d agreed to stay and work for one of my mentors until graduation. I graduated ten days ago

facts.fact: 九个月总评：最好与最坏——最好因为终于在一起、比想象更好；最坏因为几乎全程异地。
facts.anchor: The last nine months have been the best and worst of my life.

facts.fact: 家族新增：平安夜回家见两周大的 Zachary Silas Forbes（Silas=爷爷名的兑现）——Emmy 的牛主题三岁生日（12/27）、Ev 12/29 赴伦敦。
facts.anchor: I flew in on Christmas Eve to meet two-week-old Zachary Silas Forbes, the newest member of the family.

facts.fact: 搬入进行时：圣诞后 Brooks 夜夜睡在她床上——她走后他也没怎么离开她的小屋；醒来身边有他就有蝴蝶。
facts.anchor: Brooks was calling me from my bed at night, rather than his own. I don’t think he left my cabin much after I did.

facts.fact: 周年对表：Ev 夫妇结婚一周年——也是她回家疗心即将一周年；少女 crush 原来不只是 crush。
facts.anchor: celebrate a year of marriage. It’s crazy to think it’s only been a year—and that it’s coming up on a year since I came home to heal.

facts.fact: 她的反调：Forever 是个骗局——马、卡车、连很棒的性都不会永远（继续逗他）。

facts.fact: 他的抢答：好性爱会永远——胸口骄傲地挺起。
facts.anchor: “We’ll always have great sex,” he interjects. His chest puffs out a little with pride.

facts.fact: 永远的承诺词：八十岁也还是你——就算是神话也要给 forever 拼一次：你和我 devil，我们是 destiny。
facts.anchor: It’ll still be you. Maybe it is a myth, but we’re gonna give forever a damn good try, okay? You and me, devil. We’re destiny.

facts.fact: 对句回应：Me and you, demon——含泪微笑；他总是看见她，这不就是爱吗。
facts.anchor: “Me and you, demon,” I whisper. I smile through tears.

facts.fact: 地图答案：从不需要地图——只需要心；纵然伤痕累累，心总能带她去该去的地方。
facts.anchor: But it turns out I never needed a map. I just needed my heart.

facts.fact: 终句：就在牧场——有一个属于她自己的 Hart。
facts.anchor: Right here on the ranch, with a Hart of my very own.
